messages:
emily: Quick sync  we need a final editorial pass on the launch blog. Focus areas: headline tone, hero claim (performance vs. 2025 baseline), demo vs webinar CTAs, and HubSpot form mapping. Can folks reply with quick yes/no and any blockers?

rick: I can handle UTMs and campaign mapping. Plan to have two CTAs: primary = demo booking (Calendly), secondary = webinar sign-up (HubSpot). Prefer demo CTA=primary on desktop, webinar primary on mobile.

nina: Design note: hero has limited real estate. Recommend short punchline + 1-line subhead. I'll attach Figma states. Also propose testimonial pill under CTA for trust signal.

oliver: SEO check: avoid punctuation-heavy H1. Two options posted in the doc, prefer action-oriented phrasing. Also flag meta description length.

priya: Sales input: if demo booking is gated, please ask for company size and role. We sort inbound into "sales-ready" and "nurture" buckets. Also ask for timezone for scheduling.

dave-legal: Any quantitative claim (e.g., "3.1x throughput") must include a reproducibility note and link to the benchmark runbook. Also avoid absolute phrasing like "always".

kate: Product confirm: benchmark from internal harness shows ~3.1x throughput with our batching+kv-cache on ampere32. Test config: 16k context, batch 16, warmup 100. We should be explicit in footnote.

emily: Kate can you paste a one-line footnote we can drop under the claim? Legal needs it inline.

kate: Footnote draft: "Benchmark: measured across 3 runs vs. our 2025 baseline; environment: a100x, context=16384, batch=16, kv-cache enabled. See runbook: <drive/redwood/benchmarks/q2-2026-runbook.pdf>"

dave-legal: Good. Please attach the PDF link so I can confirm. Once attached, we can approve the numeric claim.

rick: Draft UTMs for the CTAs: 
```
?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch_post&utm_campaign=redwood_q2_launch_2026&utm_content=cta_{{demo|webinar}}
```
I'll set content=cta_demo for the Calendly link and content=cta_webinar for the HubSpot form.

priya: Confirming Calendly flow: we'll add an optional qualifier checkbox "We are evaluating for production (Y/N)" and fields: company, role, monthly inference volume estimate (optional). That should help SDR triage.

nina: Testimonial options for hero badge: 
- short: "Half the variance, double the throughput." (34 chars)
- long: "Switched to Redwood and cut inference cost while improving tail latency stability." (74 chars)
Which do we want on the hero?

oliver: Short on hero, long in case study block for SEO. Also request alt text for hero image: "Redwood inference dashboard with throughput chart".

emily: Decision: short for hero badge. Nina please deliver optimized SVG and small-screen variants.

kate: Also note: we should not claim "cost savings" percentage without a reproducibility table. Keep it qualitative unless legal signs off.

dave-legal: Echo. Numeric cost claims require documented baseline and calculation. The throughput claim is OK with runbook attached.

rick: HubSpot form mapping snippet (hidden fields): 
```html
<input type="hidden" name="utm_campaign" value="redwood_q2_launch_2026">
<input type="hidden" name="utm_content" value="cta_webinar">
```
I'll push the exact form to the shared forms doc and QA after legal signoff.

priya: For Calendly, please add referral parameter so we capture the UTM in the booking link. Something like: 
```
https://calendly.com/redwood/demo?utm_campaign=redwood_q2_launch_2026&utm_content=cta_demo
```

nina: Figma link posted with hero comps + CTA variants. Also added a compact layout where webinar gets prominent placement on mobile.

emily: Can we get final signoffs by 17:00 PT today? Checklist: 
- Legal (dave-legal): runbook attachment and numeric claim signoff
- SEO (oliver): headline/meta pass
- Design (nina): hero assets and testimonial SVG
- Growth (rick): UTMs & form mapping
- Sales (priya): Calendly fields and triage plan

dave-legal: I'll review the attached PDF and respond. If the runbook link is valid and contains the scripts, legal signoff ETA ~90 mins.

oliver: I'll finalize SEO copy in the doc and mark the preferred H1.

priya: Sales ready on triage. SDRs will get a report with "sales-ready" flag when qualifiers are present.

emily: Great. Target publish window: tomorrow 09:00 PT, social + email and webinar promo go out same morning. Any last blockers?

kate: No blockers from product. Attached runbook here: <drive/redwood/benchmarks/q2-2026-runbook.pdf>

dave-legal: Received and reviewing. If everything matches the footnote, legal approves the throughput claim.

emily: Thanks all. I'll assemble the final draft and post for copy approval in ~45m. Ping me if you need micro-updates. :sparkles:
